Integer i, s

Integer n, c
Set n = 100, c = 0
while(n > 1)
  n = n / 2
  c = c + 1
end while
Print c

Integer i, j, c
Set c = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 5; i = i + 1)
  for(j = 1; j <= 2; j = j + 1)
    c = c + 1
  end for
end for
Print c

Integer a
Set a = 7
Print (a << 2) | (a >> 1)

Integer big(Integer x, Integer y)
  if(x > y)
    return x
  else
    return y
  end if
End function
Print big(13, 29) + big(4, 4)

Integer a, b
Set a = 8
b = a-- + --a
Print b

Integer sum(Integer n)
  if(n <= 0)
    return 0
  end if
  return n + sum(n - 1)
End function
Print sum(5)

Integer a
Set a = 5
if(!(a == 5))
  Print 1
else
  Print 0
end if

Integer m
Set m = 12
switch(m)
  case 2: Print 28
  case 6: Print 30
  case 12: Print 31
  default: Print 12
end switch

Integer a, i

for(i = 1; i <= 4; i = i + 1)

end for
